options.glowtone.bloom.tooltip: Adds a soft glow around anything emissive.
options.glowtone.colored_lighting.toolti: Tints block light with the color of whatever is emitting it.
options.glowtone.edge_highlight.tooltip: Draws a line around exposed block edges.
options.glowtone.ambient_occlusion.toolt: Shades the inside corners where blocks meet.
options.glowtone.occlusion_strength.tool: Temporary setting, will be moved to resource packs later.
options.glowtone.smooth_animation.toolti: Makes interpolated animated textures much smoother and cleaner.
glowtone.debug.ambient_occlusion.help: F4 + G + O : Show Glowtone ambient occlusion
glowtone.debug.edge_highlight.help: F4 + G + E : Show Glowtone edge highlights
glowtone.debug.emissive_buffer.help: F4 + G + B : Show Glowtone emissive buffer
options.glowtone.shading.tooltip:
Which surfaces are dimmed by the directional lighting.
None: nothing is dimmed, including entities.
Non-emissive: glowing surfaces are lit evenly, everything else is dimmed.
All: most glowing surfaces are dimmed like any other.
